text: Seven distinct glycosidases (EC 3.2) have been characterized in guinea-pig epidermis. Their properties suggest they are of lysosomal origin. The 'profile' of the epidermal glycosidases is significantly different from that reported for whole skin, with beta-galactosidase and beta-acetylglucosaminidase exhibiting very high activity levels, while the activities of the remaining enzymes are relatively lower in epidermis compared to whole skin.
